# Klleon Chat SDK

> AI Avatar Chat JavaScript Library - Web SDK for embedding AI avatar chat interfaces


## en

- [📦 SDK Changelog](https://docs.klleon.io/en/docs/1.2.0/changelog): Check the major changes for each version of the SDK.
- [📦 Klleon Chat SDK v1.0.0](https://docs.klleon.io/en/docs/1.2.0/changelog/v1.0.0): Klleon Chat SDK v1.0.0 Release Notes
- [📦 Klleon Chat SDK v1.1.0](https://docs.klleon.io/en/docs/1.2.0/changelog/v1.1.0): Klleon Chat SDK v1.1.0 Release Notes
- [📦 Klleon Chat SDK v1.2.0](https://docs.klleon.io/en/docs/1.2.0/changelog/v1.2.0): Klleon Chat SDK v1.2.0 Release Notes
- [Custom React Example](https://docs.klleon.io/en/docs/1.2.0/examples/custom-react): An advanced example of implementing the Klleon Chat SDK fully in React without using web components. You can build a flexible UI using SDK methods like echo, changeAvatar, STT, and manage state directly.
- [React](https://docs.klleon.io/en/docs/1.2.0/examples/react): Learn how to integrate Klleon Chat SDK into your React project. From script tag installation to avatar component usage and echo message testing, this example guides you step-by-step.
- [Complete Vanilla JS Example](https://docs.klleon.io/en/docs/1.2.0/examples/vanilla-js): Run the Klleon Chat SDK directly without any installation using a Vanilla JS example. A single index.html file lets you initialize the SDK, send messages, and test echo speech.
- [TypeScript Support](https://docs.klleon.io/en/docs/1.2.0/guides/typescript-support): Learn how to use Klleon Chat SDK's TypeScript declaration file (.d.ts) in your project. Safely apply types like KlleonChat interface, InitOption, and ChatData.
- [Introduction to Klleon Chat SDK](https://docs.klleon.io/en/docs/1.2.0/intro): Klleon Chat SDK is a JavaScript library for easily implementing real-time avatar chat, speech synthesis (TTS), LLM integration, and lip sync in web applications. Start talking with avatars without any server setup.
- [Getting Started](https://docs.klleon.io/en/docs/1.2.0/setup/getting-started): Step-by-step guide to install Klleon Chat SDK and integrate avatar chat into your web application. Includes domain setup, SDK key issuance, script integration, and a working React example.
- [Event Handling](https://docs.klleon.io/en/docs/1.2.0/usage/sdk-event): Learn how to handle avatar state changes and chat messages using onChatEvent and onStatusEvent in the Klleon Chat SDK. Detailed flow of VIDEO_CAN_PLAY, chat_type, and status included.
- [SDK Methods](https://docs.klleon.io/en/docs/1.2.0/usage/sdk-method): Comprehensive guide to using Klleon Chat SDK methods. Learn how to use init, destroy, sendTextMessage, startStt, echo, changeAvatar and more to build interactive avatar chat applications.
- [Using UI Components](https://docs.klleon.io/en/docs/1.2.0/usage/ui-components): Learn how to use the Klleon Chat SDK's avatar-container and chat-container web components. Understand how to control props, apply styles, and integrate with React.
- [📦 SDK Changelog](https://docs.klleon.io/en/docs/changelog): Check the major changes for each version of the SDK.
- [📦 Klleon Chat SDK v1.0.0](https://docs.klleon.io/en/docs/changelog/v1.0.0): Klleon Chat SDK v1.0.0 Release Notes
- [📦 Klleon Chat SDK v1.1.0](https://docs.klleon.io/en/docs/changelog/v1.1.0): Klleon Chat SDK v1.1.0 Release Notes
- [📦 Klleon Chat SDK v1.2.0](https://docs.klleon.io/en/docs/changelog/v1.2.0): Klleon Chat SDK v1.2.0 Release Notes
- [📦 Klleon Chat SDK v1.3.0](https://docs.klleon.io/en/docs/changelog/v1.3.0): Klleon Chat SDK v1.3.0 Release Notes
- [Custom React Example](https://docs.klleon.io/en/docs/examples/custom-react): An advanced example of implementing the Klleon Chat SDK fully in React without using web components. You can build a flexible UI using SDK methods like echo, changeAvatar, STT, and manage state directly.
- [React](https://docs.klleon.io/en/docs/examples/react): Learn how to integrate Klleon Chat SDK into your React project. From script tag installation to avatar component usage and echo message testing, this example guides you step-by-step.
- [Complete Vanilla JS Example](https://docs.klleon.io/en/docs/examples/vanilla-js): Run the Klleon Chat SDK directly without any installation using a Vanilla JS example. A single index.html file lets you initialize the SDK, send messages, and test echo speech.
- [TypeScript Support](https://docs.klleon.io/en/docs/guides/typescript-support): Learn how to use Klleon Chat SDK's TypeScript declaration file (.d.ts) in your project. Safely apply types like KlleonChat interface, InitOption, and ChatData.
- [Introduction to Klleon Chat SDK](https://docs.klleon.io/en/docs/intro): Klleon Chat SDK is a JavaScript library for easily implementing real-time avatar chat, speech synthesis (TTS), LLM integration, and lip sync in web applications. Start talking with avatars without any server setup.
- [Getting Started](https://docs.klleon.io/en/docs/setup/getting-started): Step-by-step guide to install Klleon Chat SDK and integrate avatar chat into your web application. Includes domain setup, SDK key issuance, script integration, and a working React example.
- [Event Handling](https://docs.klleon.io/en/docs/usage/sdk-event): Learn how to handle avatar state changes, chat messages, and errors using onChatEvent, onStatusEvent, and onErrorEvent in the Klleon Chat SDK. Includes detailed ErrorCode descriptions and error event flow.
- [SDK Methods](https://docs.klleon.io/en/docs/usage/sdk-method): Comprehensive guide to using Klleon Chat SDK methods. Learn how to use init, destroy, sendTextMessage, startStt, echo, changeAvatar and more to build interactive avatar chat applications.
- [Using UI Components](https://docs.klleon.io/en/docs/usage/ui-components): Learn how to use the Klleon Chat SDK's avatar-container and chat-container web components. Understand how to control props, apply styles, and integrate with React.
